reference_input: tests/fixtures/stress_signal.wav (golden input; equals the golden_wavenet_a2_max.bin input section bit-exactly)
capture_scope: rendered frames only; DSP::prewarm silent frames are excluded

film_layout.packing: frame-major: [frame: slot 0..15 concatenated]; slots have variable channels; per-frame floats = 72
film_layout.slot_order: slot = layer_ordinal*8 + family_index (single main LayerArray, 2 layers); family order conv_pre_film, conv_post_film, input_mixin_pre_film, input_mixin_post_film, activation_pre_film, activation_post_film, layer1x1_post_film, head1x1_post_film
